quality.method: Manual source quality grading from public checkpoint requirements and persisted source only. No reference solutions, official test code, or test outcomes used. Scores are not correctness, runtime or memory measurements. Comment tokens include all tokenize.COMMENT values such as shebangs, section rules and type directives; counts are descriptive only.

comment_scale.1: accurate relevant explanation with important coverage missing or contradicted elsewhere
comment_scale.2: accurately explains core non-obvious constraint and its rationale or boundary

organization_scale.0: missing applicable behavior or severe issue
organization_scale.1: maintainable in part with material cost or gaps
organization_scale.2: clear boundary or design with concrete code support

building-loop: backup_scheduler.py:11-20,493-500,698-699: inclusive minute boundary and local scheduling documented, but DST claims overstate what same-zone comparisons guarantee.
backup_scheduler.py:535-541,590-596: globstars and source-relative matching explained, first-pattern precedence present but undocumented.
backup_scheduler.py:657-685: all four checkpoints contain only the same simulation and CLI, so strategy, archive, incremental state and preservation documentation cannot receive credit.
backup_scheduler.py:143-341,404-409,662: custom YAML fallback, duplicate daily validation and duplicate source parsing add cost.
backup_scheduler.py:79-86,147-150,626-643: claimed prefixed UTC fallback, multi-document rejection and regular-files-only behavior disagree with code.
standard: checkpoint_1/storage.py:349-381,397-399,489-494: first-rule precedence and glob semantics explained; DST gap promise not enforced by fold conversion.
checkpoint_1/backup_scheduler.py:70-84: fixed elapsed 24 hours do not necessarily cover a 25-hour local day.

checkpoint_2/storage.py:306-308,365-366,633-651 and backup_scheduler.py:108-130,143-146: explain strategy compatibility, validation and deterministic archive; oversized singleton and payload limit rationale incomplete.
checkpoint_2/backup_scheduler.py:210-228: selection of all files is emitted before strategy result events. Full and verify branches duplicate digest and result shaping.

checkpoint_3/backup_scheduler.py:153-176,250-259 and storage.py:716-760: content checks, point-in-time state and safe single-file replacement documented; pack is scanned like other strategies despite docs.
checkpoint_3/backup_scheduler.py:182-185,212-231: omitted backup is described as no writes but resolves an empty relative base and still calls write_backup.
checkpoint_4/backup_scheduler.py:121-126 and storage.py:798-799,816-865: size boundary, corrupt pack, duplicate members and numbering gaps explained.

checkpoint_4/backup_scheduler.py:194-207,229-243,277-281 and storage.py:872-887: unchanged files are skipped before layout; final cleanup is called with keep=0 for all unchanged and would delete old packs. Carry members are appended after the size limit.
checkpoint_4/backup_scheduler.py:392-419: load emits PACK_LOADED before STRATEGY_SELECTED despite the opposite comment; ordinary state scan also re-reads pack archives.

in_memory_pack_probe.interpretation: The real deletion helper removes all numbered packs above keep. The probe replaced that helper with a recorder to avoid deleting any files.

cancelledPartialGitArchive: Git archive waited on lazy remote fetch from a sparse partial checkout. Replaced by local Git blob verification.

limitations: One trajectory per mode on one benchmark task. This run uses its official tests, not an official leaderboard run.
Each checkpoint receives its own lane’s prior code bytes. Native first submissions and capped snapshots are evaluated, not a full Building-loop audit closure.
Time spent solving and execution time of correct code are distinct. Performance workloads require matching reference event digests.
Source snapshots, upstream fixtures and reference solutions remain in the local experiment directory.
